instruction: Configure LibreOffice Writer to use Arial as the default font for all newly created documents

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the default font for LibreOffice Writer to Arial. The evaluator checks the LibreOffice configuration file (registrymodifications.xcu) to verify that the Standard font setting under DefaultFont is set to 'Arial'. Similar difficulty to original task which sets Times New Roman as default font.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly targets the LibreOffice configuration file (registrymodifications.xcu) where default font settings are stored
Metric function uses correct XML parsing with proper XPath (.//item[@oor:path='/org.openoffice.Office.Writer/DefaultFont']) to locate the Standard font property
Expected parameter handling is correct: directly accesses rules['font_name'] (not rules.get('rules', {})), which is proper for type='rule'
Semantic coverage is complete: evaluator verifies exactly what the instruction requires (default font set to Arial)
Logic flow is sound: getter fetches config file -> metric parses XML -> compares against expected font name
Minor issue: No postconfig to ensure LibreOffice has persisted settings to disk, but this may be handled at framework level
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding a postconfig step to close LibreOffice or trigger settings save to ensure registrymodifications.xcu is updated before evaluation
Could improve error handling to distinguish between 'file not found' vs 'wrong font configured' for better debugging
